readinessSemantics.sourceReadiness: Reviewed Canon, Foundations, or contract support for the stated capability; it does not imply an admitted interpretation method.
readinessSemantics.semanticMethodReadiness: An admitted deterministic composition method exists; it does not imply a Signal, synthesis, or production fact.
readinessSemantics.signalPolicyReadiness: A closed, provenance-preserving structured Signal policy exists; it does not imply a reader-facing theme.
readinessSemantics.synthesisReadiness: The bounded deterministic synthesis boundary can use the capability without evidence inflation, repetition, or authority substitution.
readinessSemantics.productionFactAuthority: The production Engine/BFF/provider boundary can supply the required fact authoritatively for the intended use; a contract shape alone is insufficient.

validationAssertions.requirement: All major mature coverage layers are represented in capabilities.
BOUNDED_POC_ONLY and FUTURE_SCOPE are distinct from mature target need.
Every capability records all five readiness dimensions.
Source or contract readiness never silently becomes production fact authority.
Semantic method readiness is independent of production fact authority.
Unknown-time behavior and omitted time-dependent facts are explicit.
3–5 is a target, fewer are allowed, and more candidates are selected/merged/subsumed/moved.
One fact is not an automatic primary card.
The six closed domains do not require one card per domain.
Sun, Moon, and ASC do not automatically become three primary cards.
A compatible relational unit may subsume placement themes while retaining provenance.
Supporting factors may remain in WHY, Learn, Astrologer's View, or secondary depth.
Provider/scientific authority remains a separate open gate.
No capability authorizes astronomy calculation or runtime wiring in Web.
